entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-7881-B45. It's for the Trail Helmet I bought. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this is the first time I've ever had to call.
I appreciate your loyalty, thank you for that. Let me just pull up that order... VF-7881-B45. Okay, I see the Trail Helmet, delivered about 40 days ago. What seems to be the issue with it?

It's the color. On the website, it looked like a deep forest green, but in person... it's more of a lime green. I feel so silly, but I just can't wear it. I know safety is the most important thing with a helmet, but I just don't feel good in it.
I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can change how a color appears. Is there any damage to the item?

Oh, no! Not at all. The box is unopened, I swear. I saw the color through the little plastic window and my heart just sank. I really needed that money for some unexpected bills, and I feel so guilty for spending it on something I can't even use.

I see. Let me just double-check our policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've got it. Since the item was delivered 40 days ago and is still in its original condition, it falls well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? So I can send it back for a full refund?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return process in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
Wow, thank you so much, David. That's a huge relief. You have no idea. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
